Torch and Light often gets mismanaged - torches burn for 1 hour of real time.

GMs: Set a timer for each torch's 1-hour real-time burn to avoid players stumbling around in the dark.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

College of Glamour's Mantle of Inspiration surprises with its efficiency - a bonus action grants temporary HP.

DMs: Use Mantle of Inspiration's bonus action for consistent temporary HP; it's your reliable tool, not a flashy distraction.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Experience Points are earned in small amounts - 0 to 4 points per encounter based on danger.

Judges: Award 0-4 XP per encounter based on danger; stop rewarding players for grinding through trivial fights.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Winter Wolf earns its stakes fast.

GMs: Remind them that clustering invites disaster; the Winter Wolf's Frost Breath recharges in 1d4 rounds, not the usual longer wait.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Cover often gets misinterpreted - three degrees of cover modify attack rolls and saving throws.

DMs: Use the cover table to correct players who mistake half cover for total cover; line of sight matters.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Cure Paralysis changes encounter dynamics more than players expect - at a spell check of 16-19.

Judges: Remind them to aim for a 16-19 spell check on Cure Paralysis to affect multiple targets and shift the battle.

Sphere Of Annihilation obliterates everything it touches - DC 18 Intelligence check to control it.

GMs: Identify a DC 18 Intelligence check moment to control the Sphere and bypass a deadly encounter entirely.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Run Quickling as a moral-choice encounter: they can protect everyone, or finish the objective before the cost spikes.

DMs: Make them choose - secure the objective or save the villagers as Quicklings exploit their 120-foot speed to wreak havoc.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Large Scorpion's poison is more potent than expected - 1d6 damage with a DC 12 Fort save to negate.

Judges: Pin the scorpion in a tight corridor to exploit its 30' movement and force those DC 12 poison saves.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Nine Lives Stealer's instant kill potential only triggers on a natural 20 - DC 15 Constitution save required.

DMs: Save the Nine Lives Stealer's charges for when a creature with fewer than 100 HP fails the DC 15 Constitution save.

Ability Score Loss can disable a character entirely - hitting 0 in any score has catastrophic effects.

Judges: Have a ghoul drain 2 Strength to show them how quickly immobility becomes a real threat.
